scenes.vo_text: March 2026. LaGuardia, runway four. A jet is cleared to land. Seconds later, a fire truck is cleared to cross the same runway. Two clearances. One runway.

Truck one and company, cross runway four at Delta.

scenes.vo_text: Hold Short is a safety net for control towers. Agents listen to every radio stream, log each call in MongoDB Atlas, and stop clearances that conflict.

Same calls, Safety on. ElevenLabs cleans and transcribes each transmission into Atlas. A change stream fires our rule engine: deterministic, no LLM in the decision. The stop goes to the controller who owns the runway, and Hold Short says it on the radio.

And every agent is auditable. Agents can only file intents; three layers block anything else, and every attempt is logged. Switch an agent off and its next intent is refused. Then rewind: the whole event, rebuilt from stored records alone.
scenes.title: The AI can stop traffic. It can never clear it.
